definitions.explanation: A Japanese Buddhist festival to honor the spirits of ancestors, typically held in mid-August.

examples.japanese: お{盆|ぼん}に{故郷|ふるさと}に{帰|かえ}る。
examples.english: I return to my hometown during Obon.

examples.japanese: お{盆|ぼん}は{先祖|せんぞ}の{霊|れい}を{迎|むか}える{行事|ぎょうじ}だ。
examples.english: Obon is an event to welcome the spirits of ancestors.

examples.japanese: お{盆|ぼん}{休|やす}みに{旅行|りょこう}する。
examples.english: I travel during the Obon holiday.

notes:
お{盆|ぼん} (Obon) is one of the three major holidays in Japan, along with New Year and Golden Week.

CULTURAL TRADITIONS:
- {盆踊|ぼんおど}り: Bon dance
- {迎|むか}え{火|び}: welcoming fire
- {送|おく}り{火|び}: sending fire
- {墓参|はかまい}り: visiting graves

TIMING:
The dates vary by region (mid-July or mid-August), but August 13-16 is most common.
